status: PRESPECIFIED (written and hashed before any result is read; coordinator ruling 2026-10-26)
question: Do epithelial (consumer) metabolic states depend on producer-side metabolism measured specifically in the stromal-immune neighbourhood, beyond shared-environment coordination?

cohorts.intervals: patient-bootstrap over the pooled held-out patients
per-patient held-out gains, unit bootstrap and sign count (the < 8-patient rule)

spots: epithelial-dominant spots: CellViT epithelial + neoplastic nuclear fraction >= 0.5 (tissue_architecture.MIN_EPITHELIAL) on covered spots

explanatory.stromal_neighbour_term: nbrS6 and nbrS18: the producer programme averaged over the 6 / 18 nearest neighbours that are stromal-immune dominant (M's operators)
explanatory.epithelial_neighbour_term: nbrE6 and nbrE18: the SAME producer programme averaged over the epithelial-dominant neighbours (swap control, in the same model)
explanatory.model: one model per (target, producer programme, radius): target ~ f(nbrS, nbrE) with relation v03_rff (256 RFF + linear terms, LOPO penalty from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10}), patient folds, baselines B_nuis and B_known (relation_v03.known_covariates; overlapping programmes as the registered rule, reported with the second-catalogue flag)

declared_success: for at least one (target, producer, radius) cell, all of: (1) the stromal-neighbour term carries held-out gain beyond B_known (drop-one gain of nbrS within the joint model, patient-bootstrap CI > 0) that the epithelial-neighbour term does not (drop-one gain of nbrE CI includes 0 or is smaller with the difference CI > 0); (2) the stromal-neighbour partial slope has the complementary sign (opposite direction to the epithelial-neighbour slope, or the sign expected for producer-consumer coupling: producer glycolysis/MCT4 up -> consumer OXPHOS/MCT1 up); (3) the stromal gain survives the composition-matched null (stromal-dominant neighbour sets replaced by random neighbour sets matched on the stromal fraction), (4) the Moran-matched smooth-programme null (producer programme replaced by Moran-matched random gene programmes), and (5) a distance-ring decay: the stromal-neighbour gain at ring 1 >= ring 2 >= ring 3 (rings of the hexagonal grid), with ring 1 > ring 3 by a bootstrap CI.
multiplicity: BH over the 3 targets x 3 producers x 2 radii = 18 cells within each cohort; q <= 0.10
reported_regardless: calibration slope of the frozen model across patient folds
sign of the stromal partial slope per patient
failure_statement: If no cell meets the declared success: 'no evidence of compartment-complementary metabolic dependency beyond shared-environment coordination' (the P1 line).
dependencies: runs when M's nbrS6/nbrS18/nbrE6/nbrE18 operators land; the operator definitions are recorded with their commit in the result
multiplicity_note: Meylan is the primary cohort; CRC v03 is a direction contrast and does not enter the Meylan BH family
